t: This 4lite rectangular LED bulkhead provides reliable emergency lighting for various applications. Its robust polycarbonate construction ensures durability and corrosion-resistance, making it suitable for both indoor and outdoor installations, such as workshops, corridors, or commercial stairwells. The unit features a LiFePO4 lithium battery for extended reliability and a quick-release LED array for straightforward maintenance. Installation is flexible with 20mm side, end, and rear cable entries, and it offers maintained or non-maintained operation with a 3-hour emergency run time. A self-test function enhances safety and compliance, while the 18m viewing distance ensures clear visibility.
b: 4 Year Manufacturer’s Guarantee (Registration Required, T&Cs Apply)
